dct_description_sm:
This dataset shows the alignments of the railway tracks including Crane Container, Burlington Northern, Canadian National, Canadian Pacific, Downtown Historical, VIA and Wisconsin Central Railways.

Data currency

The extract for this dataset is updated weekly. There may be no change in data content from one week to the next because there is no change in source data. Priorities and resources will also determine how fast a change in reality is reflected in the database.

Data accuracy

The locations shown may not be exact but they are reasonable approximations of the true locations of the railway lines. This data has not been created with survey accuracy.
